doc:
# Minimal Surface — Wilson Loops

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “minimal surface Wilson loop”).

claims.name: searching_worldsheet_minimal_surface_numerically
claims.statement: Searching the world-sheet minimal surface numerically determines the Wilson loop expectation value.

sources.title: Confinement of N=1 Super Yang-Mills from Supergravity

claims.name: minimal_area_surface_used_dual
claims.statement: The minimal area surface is used as the dual probe of Wilson-loop expectation values.

claims.name: minimal_surface_dual_cusped_wilson
claims.statement: The minimal surface is dual to a cusped Wilson loop in the dual field theory.

sources.title: Holographic Cusped Wilson loops in $q$-deformed $AdS_5\times S^5$ Spacetime

claims.name: scattering_amplitude_wilson_loop_duality
claims.statement: In the scattering amplitude/Wilson loop duality, the minimal surface ends on a light-like polygonal Wilson loop at the boundary of anti-de Sitter (AdS) space.

sources.title: A short review on TBA equation and scattering amplitude/Wilson loop duality

claims.name: minimal_surface_ads_supposed_describe
claims.statement: The minimal surface in $AdS_5$ is supposed to describe the Wilson loop for large coupling $\lambda$.

claims.name: circular_minimalsurface_solution_reduces_bps
claims.statement: The circular minimal-surface solution reduces to a $1/2$ BPS circular Wilson loop in the $q\to 1$ limit.

sources.title: Minimal surfaces in $q$-deformed AdS$_5\times$S$^5$ with Poincare coordinates

claims.name: thermalization_boundary_quantum_field_theory
claims.statement: Thermalization in the boundary quantum field theory is probed by a minimal area surface dual to Wilson-loop expectation values.

sources.title: Effect of phantom dark energy on the holographic thermalization

claims.name: circular_wilson_loop_minimal_surface
claims.statement: For the circular Wilson loop minimal surface, the induced worldsheet metric is again that of $AdS_2$ with $\mathcal{R}=-2$.

sources.title: Green-Schwarz String in AdS_5 x S^5: Semiclassical Partition Function

claims.name: condensed_phase_wilson_loop_average
claims.statement: In the condensed phase, the Wilson loop average can be approximated by a solitonic saddle point localized around the minimal surface.

sources.title: The infrared Yang-Mills wave functional due to percolating center vortices

claims.name: if_wilson_loop_plane_curve
claims.statement: If the Wilson loop is a plane curve, the relevant minimal surface lies in hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}_{3}$ (Euclidean AdS$_{3}$).

sources.title: Wilson loops and minimal area surfaces in hyperbolic space

claims.name: perturbation_theory_latitude_angle_provides
claims.statement: Perturbation theory in the latitude angle provides an expansion near the AdS$_{2}$ minimal surface representing the 1/2 BPS circular Wilson loop.

sources.title: Perturbative computation of string one-loop corrections to Wilson loop minimal surfaces in $AdS_5 \times S^5$

claims.name: wilson_line_wilson_loop_correlation
claims.statement: Wilson line and Wilson loop correlation functions in the AdS/CFT framework exhibit a relation between minimal surface problems in $AdS_5$ metrics and reggeization in gauge field theory at strong coupling.

sources.title: Minimal surfaces and Reggeization in the AdS/CFT correspondence

claims.name: supersymmetric_wilson_loop_expectation_value
claims.statement: A supersymmetric Wilson loop expectation value is represented by a type-IIA string partition function expanded around an $AdS_2 \subset AdS_3$ minimal surface.

sources.title: Wilson loop in AdS$_3 \times S^3 \times T^4$ from quantum M2 brane

claims.name: loop_string_correction_latitude_minimal
claims.statement: The 1-loop string correction to the latitude minimal surface in AdS$_{5}$ × S$^{5}$ is revisited for the 1/4 BPS Wilson loop in planar $ \mathcal{N}=4 $ SYM theory.

sources.title: Perturbative computation of string one-loop corrections to Wilson loop minimal surfaces in $AdS_5 \times S^5$

claims.name: minimal_surface_solution_associated_bps
claims.statement: The minimal surface solution associated with the 1/4 BPS Wilson loop depends on an arbitrary point on $S^3$, giving exactly three moduli as predicted by supersymmetry.

claims.name: if_interested_computing_wilson_loop
claims.statement: If we are interested in computing the Wilson loop expectation value, considering quantum fluctuations about such a minimal surface will not change the boundary conditions of the fields.

sources.title: Scattering into the fifth dimension of N=4 super Yang-Mills

claims.name: if_wilson_loop_euclidean_lies
claims.statement: If a Wilson loop is Euclidean and lies in a $(t,x)$ plane, the dual minimal surface is Euclidean and lies in Lorentzian AdS$_{3}$ inside AdS$_{5}$.

sources.title: Euclidean Wilson loops and Minimal Area Surfaces in Minkowski AdS3

claims.name: field_theories_dual_lifshitz_spacetimes
claims.statement: For field theories dual to Lifshitz spacetimes, the leading IR singularity in the scattering amplitude is determined from the bulk minimal surface of the simplest cusp Wilson loop.
